notes.title: Steam Awards 2023 - Nominate Space Pirates for Life!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]HELLO YOU WONDERFUL SPACE PIRATES! [/b][/h3]

Do you think our songs [b][i]slap[/i][/b]? Well let us band together and vote for SPFL to have a fighting chance to win the award for best soundtrack! 


[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2342710/ss_d96c7247e4f6f67f76fe3679689fb420e88e2df1.1920x1080.jpg?t=1683121797[/img]
[i]Fun fact: The game's only developer wrote all of the music within a solid week of hard work using Logic Pro with one track even taking 40 minutes of intense writing, production and exporting before having to attend to non-dev life![/i]


We would simply be [b]over the moon[/b] for any votes we receive - if this performs well enough, we will consider making the soundtrack available to listen to online! ːsteamthumbsupː 

Let's give this a good shot. Big love - Tidal Rave

[img]https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQUpCZzFCznbfppn4WKGhHbTgbcUB40vOzIA0D6n4hkFWkytnEKZze6UfuKvc5XlRJaG7g&usqp=CAU[/img]

notes.title: Keybinding Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
You can now manually edit the keyboard controls in the game settings. Here are the following changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Major keybinding update
[*] The first boss is now updated to be less 'awkward'
[*] Mini Boss Code Updated
[*] A few wall collision updates
[*] Map bug fix
[/list]

Thank you to all who have provided feedback which influenced these changes. We hope you keep enjoying our game.

Tidal Rave x

notes.title: SPACE PIRATES FOR LIFE - Official Release This Friday! (28/04/2023)
notes.notes:
The time is upon us! The official Alpha release is arriving on Steam this Friday and we are looking forward to sharing our creation with you all - 9 months of love has gone into the creation of this project and it's looking good for our first attempt at making a game!

[i](Note: As this is a new release, there is so much opportunity to set new world records as there are achievements even the game dev has not yet achieved!)[/i]

[h1]Ways to Help Us Out Before Release:[/h1]

[list]
[*] All you have to do is add Space Pirates for Life to your Wishlist and that is all.
[/list]

[h1]Ways to Help Us Out On/After the Release Date:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Purchase the game for a generous $2.99
[*] Leave us a nice review :-) 
[*] Post comments/screenshots/artwork/memes in the community
[*] Share the game with your friends
[/list]

We look forward to having you play our game and best of luck with unlocking our new Single Release!

Tidal Rave ːsteamhappyː
